pressure.instructions: How much pressure or urgency does the speaker put on the listener?
criteria: Strong threats or demands to act now

payment_ask.instructions: What kind of payment or sensitive access is the speaker asking for?

criteria.none: no payment or access is requested
criteria.known_bill_known_payee: an ordinary bill from a known company
criteria.gift_cards_crypto_or_wire: gift cards, cryptocurrency or a wire transfer
criteria.remote_access_request: installing software or sharing the screen
criteria.password_or_code_request: a password, PIN or one-time code

impersonation.instructions: Who does the speaker claim to be?

criteria.relative_in_trouble: a relative who is in trouble

secrecy.instructions: Does the speaker ask the listener to hide this from family or bank staff?
